# Naguib Mahfouz — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Naguib Mahfouz known for?", "Cairo Trilogy"),

    ("What is field?", "novel"),

    ("What is note?", "1988 Nobel"),
]

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
